additional_applications.title: Defining Z in Q
locations: Proof of Proposition 6, Facts (a),(b),(c),(e), printed page 77
additional_applications.application: The norm-one reduced trace set of quaternion algebra (2,3), ramification exactly at 2 and 3, local residue criteria U_2={1}, U_3={0}, no extra split-finite or real restriction, and local-to-global trace membership
additional_applications.separate_elementary_step: For a,b rational, h=9+3(a^2+b^2) lies in that trace set exactly when both a,b are integral at 2 and 3; the h in 4Z_2 branch is proved in the author note
additional_applications.not_sufficient_alone: The older equality T=S+S=Z_(2) intersect Z_(3) does not by itself prove the new one-trace criterion
